column1: # AnarchyKenshi site-table names (v0.133.1) matched to KenshiLib 0.5.0 declarations by address offset.

# Method: KenshiLib header comments give an RVA for an unknown Kenshi build; within a code region that RVA differs from the Steam 1.0.68 RVA (exe a596ab4e...aeb1) by one constant. For each AK row the delta shared by the most AK rows within 0x30000 is taken (support = how many neighbours share it). Inferred: a row with low support or a non-matching name can be wrong. Use the KenshiLib name (resolved per build by KenshiLib at run time), not the RVA.
